test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: As part of the partial work from home process, Amita went to office every 2nd day, Amrita went to office every 3rd day, and Tosita went to office every 6th day, respectively. All three went to office on 31 October 2021. On how many days did all three attend office on the same date during the remaining two months of the year?
solution:
**Given:**

Amita goes every 2nd day

Amrita goes every 3rd day

Tosita goes every 6th day

All went on 31 Oct 2021

Find number of common attendance days in Nov & Dec 2021

**Formula used:**

Find LCM of 2, 3, and 6 = Common interval when all three attend together

**Calculation:**

LCM(2, 3, 6) = 6 → All attend every 6th day

Days from 1 Nov to 31 Dec = 30 (Nov) + 31 (Dec) = 61 days

We start counting from 31 Oct, so next common attendance = 6th day after 31 Oct = 6 Nov

List all dates from 6 Nov to 31 Dec with gap of 6 days:

6 Nov, 12 Nov, 18 Nov, 24 Nov, 30 Nov

6 Dec, 12 Dec, 18 Dec, 24 Dec, 30 Dec

Total = 10 dates

**∴ All three attended office together on 10 days during Nov & Dec 2021**
